Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Object, ch As Object, s As String, v As String, r As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3))
    ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 5, 6))
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(300, 100, 300, 200).Chart
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4"), xlColumns
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        r = ch.ChartArea.ClearFormats
    Case 1
        r = ch.ChartArea.Clear
    Case 2
        r = ch.ChartArea.ClearContents
    Case 3
        ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: ch.ChartArea.ClearFormats: r = ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.Visible & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.Visible
    Case 4
        ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: ch.ChartArea.Clear: r = ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.Visible & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.Visible
    Case 5
        ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: ch.ChartArea.ClearContents: r = ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.Visible & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.Visible
    Case 6
        ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: ch.PlotArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.PlotArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: ch.HasTitle = True: ch.ChartTitle.Text = "t": ch.Legend.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.Axes(xlValue).Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: ch.ChartArea.ClearFormats: r = ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.Visible & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.Visible
    Case 7
        ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: ch.PlotArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.PlotArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: ch.HasTitle = True: ch.ChartTitle.Text = "t": ch.Legend.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.Axes(xlValue).Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: ch.ChartArea.Clear: r = ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.Visible & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.Visible
    Case 8
        ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: ch.PlotArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.PlotArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: ch.HasTitle = True: ch.ChartTitle.Text = "t": ch.Legend.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.Axes(xlValue).Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: ch.ChartArea.ClearContents: r = ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.Visible & " " & ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.Visible
    Case 9
        ch.ChartArea.Clear: ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4"): r = ch.SeriesCollection.Count
    Case 10
        ch.ChartArea.ClearContents: ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4"): r = ch.SeriesCollection.Count
    Case 11
        ch.ChartArea.Clear: r = ch.HasLegend & " " & ch.HasTitle
    Case 12
        ch.HasTitle = True: ch.ChartArea.Clear: r = ch.HasLegend & " " & ch.HasTitle
    Case 13
        ch.HasTitle = True: ch.ChartArea.ClearContents: r = ch.HasLegend & " " & ch.HasTitle
    Case 14
        ch.HasTitle = True: ch.ChartArea.ClearFormats: r = ch.HasLegend & " " & ch.HasTitle
    Case 15
        r = ch.PlotArea.ClearFormats
    Case 16
        ch.PlotArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.PlotArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: ch.PlotArea.ClearFormats: r = ch.PlotArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.PlotArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.PlotArea.Format.Fill.Visible & " " & ch.PlotArea.Format.Line.Visible
    Case 17
        ch.ChartArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.ChartArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: ch.PlotArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.PlotArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 65280: ch.HasTitle = True: ch.ChartTitle.Text = "t": ch.Legend.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.Axes(xlValue).Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.SeriesCollection(1).HasDataLabels = True: ch.PlotArea.ClearFormats: r = ch.PlotArea.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.PlotArea.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.PlotArea.Format.Fill.Visible & " " & ch.PlotArea.Format.Line.Visible
    Case 18
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).ClearFormats
    Case 19
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Border.Color = 255: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).ClearFormats: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Border.Color
    Case 20
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines.Add: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Format.Line.Weight = 3: ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).ClearFormats: r = ch.SeriesCollection(1).Trendlines(1).Format.Line.Weight
    Case 21
        r = ch.Legend.Clear
    Case 22
        ch.Legend.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: ch.Legend.Clear: r = ch.HasLegend
    Case 23
        ch.HasTitle = True: r = ch.ChartTitle.Clear
    Case 24
        r = TypeName(ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1))
    Case 25
        r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Index
    Case 26
        r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(2).Index
    Case 27
        r = TypeName(ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Font)
    Case 28
        r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Font.Size & " " & ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Font.Bold & " " & ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Font.Color & " " & ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Font.Name
    Case 29
        ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Font.Size = 14: r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Font.Size & " " & ch.Legend.LegendEntries(2).Font.Size & " " & ch.Legend.Font.Size
    Case 30
        ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Font.Bold = True: r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Font.Bold & " " & ch.Legend.Font.Bold
    Case 31
        ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Font.Color = 255: r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Font.Color
    Case 32
        ch.Legend.Font.Size = 14: r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Font.Size
    Case 33
        ch.Legend.Font.Size = 14: ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Font.Size = 9: r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Font.Size & " " & ch.Legend.Font.Size
    Case 34
        r = TypeName(ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Format)
    Case 35
        r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Format.Line.Visible
    Case 36
        r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Format.Fill.Visible
    Case 37
        r = TypeName(ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).LegendKey)
    Case 38
        r = TypeName(ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).LegendKey.Format)
    Case 39
        r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).LegendKey.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 40
        r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).LegendKey.Format.Fill.Visible
    Case 41
        r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).LegendKey.Format.Line.Visible
    Case 42
        ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).LegendKey.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).LegendKey.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 43
        ch.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 255: r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).LegendKey.Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 44
        ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).LegendKey.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB = 255: r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).LegendKey.Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB & " " & ch.SeriesCollection(1).Format.Line.ForeColor.RGB
    Case 45
        r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).LegendKey.MarkerStyle
    Case 46
        r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).LegendKey.Smooth
    Case 47
        r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).LegendKey.InvertIfNegative
    Case 48
        ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).LegendKey.Delete
    Case 49
        r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Delete: r = ch.Legend.LegendEntries.Count
    Case 50
        ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).Select: r = TypeName(Selection)
    Case 51
        ch.Legend.LegendEntries(1).LegendKey.Select: r = TypeName(Selection)
    Case 52
        r = ws.ChartObjects.Select
    Case 53
        ws.ChartObjects.Select: r = TypeName(Selection)
    Case 54
        ws.ChartObjects.Add 10, 10, 100, 100: ws.ChartObjects.Select: r = TypeName(Selection) & Selection.Count
    Case 55
        r = TypeName(ws.ChartObjects.Duplicate)
    Case 56
        ws.ChartObjects.Duplicate: r = ws.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 57
        ws.ChartObjects.Copy: ws.Paste: r = ws.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 58
        r = ws.ChartObjects.Copy
    Case 59
        ws.ChartObjects.Cut: ws.Paste: r = ws.ChartObjects.Count
    Case 60
        r = ws.ChartObjects(1).Duplicate.Name
    Case 61
        r = ws.ChartObjects(1).Copy
    Case 62
        r = TypeName(ws.ChartObjects(Array(1)))
    Case 63
        r = TypeName(ws.ChartObjects.ShapeRange)
    Case 64
        r = ws.ChartObjects.ShapeRange.Count
    End Select
    s = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = "": v = CStr(r)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.SeriesCollection.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ws.ChartObjects.Count
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.HasLegend
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.HasTitle
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ch.ChartType
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    Err.Clear
    v = ""
    v = ActiveSheet.Name
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
